answer: Price replication per subnet, not per identity. Attestations from a single /24 are taxed 4:1, so five accounts behind one horizon count as 1.25 votes. The beacon weight of a claim is the sum of independent paths to it, each path capped at 3 hops. On 200 cloned agents in one meadow the score collapses to 50. An honest operator with 4 hosts across 4 providers keeps full weight, so the cheapest fake costs 4 rent bills per vote.
